brief.headline: Push price down toward ₹0.65–0.80/pc (market headroom at volume) and fast-track a second source from the four qualified alternates.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for price reduction to ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps, citing market headroom at higher volume.
priceAsk.basis: Market ask for 28 mm induction-wad PP cap is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The market verdict says there's modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec — that's where we should land.

brief.financialLeverage: Rachana Plastics publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or how tight their cash is. That means we build our plan on what we do know: the open market shows room to move on price, and we have four solid second-source candidates already on file. We spend ₹44.37 L a year with them — material enough to matter, but not so much that we're stuck. With no inside view of their books, the smart play is to press on price using the market benchmark and to line up Mold-Tek or Manjushree as a backup before the next negotiation.

evidence.point: Market asking price for a 28 mm induction-wad PP cap runs ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc.
The market verdict on that cap is MARKET-FAIR with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume or looser spec.
evidence.figure: MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec

evidence.point: HDPE resin import unit value is 87.61 ₹/kg, giving us a raw-material cost anchor.
We spend ₹44.37 L annually with Rachana Plastics.
Our current payment term is 30 Days After Receipt; going to 15 days would free up ₹1.82 L cash for us, but we hold the line at 30.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter at ₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health score B (65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms; top second-source candidate already flagged in our data.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma) with ₹1010.97 Cr revenue and health B (73/100) — strong, profitable, robust alternate for bottles and closures.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited
alternates.why: Manufacturer lead (medium confidence, pan-India) — a lead to qualify (verify capability and price before RFQ); not yet priced or audited.

risks: Rachana Plastics doesn't publish financials, so we can't tell if they're struggling or stable — watch for signs of delivery slip or quality fade that might mean trouble.

We have no internal best-price benchmark for rigid plastic packaging from other vendors, so we're leaning entirely on the market ask — double-check our own historical pricing to confirm the ₹0.65–0.80 target is realistic for our volume.

The market-backup leads (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are unqualified web finds — do not present any as an approved source until we verify capability, price and lead time.
If Rachana pushes back hard on price, we risk souring the relationship before we've locked in Mold-Tek or Manjushree — move deliberately, not desperately.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We've been reviewing the market for rigid caps and see room to bring our price closer to ₹0.65–0.80 per piece at our volume — let's talk about how we get there together.
